preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer n, where 1 ≤ n ≤ 500.

preconditions.expression: len(p) == n and all(1 <= x <= n for x in p) and len(set(p)) == n
preconditions.description: The second line contains exactly n integers p₁, p₂, ..., pₙ, each between 1 and n, and all distinct (a permutation of {1, 2, ..., n}).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (all(len(line.split()) == i for i, line in enumerate(stdout.strip().splitlines(), 1)) and len(stdout.strip().splitlines()) == n)
postconditions.description: If no solution exists, output is exactly '-1'. Otherwise, output consists of exactly n lines, where the i-th line contains exactly i integers.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() != '-1' and all(1 <= int(x) <= n for line in stdout.strip().splitlines() for x in line.split())
postconditions.description: Every cell in the output grid contains an integer between 1 and n (inclusive).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() != '-1' and all(int(stdout.strip().splitlines()[i-1].split()[j-1]) == p[i-1] for i in range(1, n+1) for j in range(1, i+1) if i == j)
postconditions.description: For each cell (i, i) on the main diagonal, the output value equals p[i-1] (the region number assigned to the diagonal cell).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() != '-1' and all(sum(1 for line in stdout.strip().splitlines() for x in line.split() if int(x) == k) == k for k in range(1, n+1))
postconditions.description: For each region k (1 ≤ k ≤ n), the total number of cells assigned to region k is exactly k.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() != '-1' and all(connected_region(stdout.strip(), k) for k in range(1, n+1))
postconditions.description: For each region k (1 ≤ k ≤ n), the cells assigned to region k form a connected region (4-directionally adjacent).
